players.product: photonic quantum systems built on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) chips

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc (10-K): in February 2026 acquired Luminar Semiconductor, Inc. (LSI), adding chip-scale laser diodes, semiconductor optical amplifiers, avalanche photodiodes, passive waveguides and photonic integrated circuits, an in-house III-V photonic semiconductor fabrication facility and photonics module manufacturing, serving customers in industries that include aerospace and defense and sensing and instrumentation.

players.product: TFLN photonic chip foundry services (AZ Chips Facility, ASU Research Park, Tempe AZ)

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc (10-K): develops proprietary TFLN optical chip designs for exclusive use in its products, while its foundry services at the AZ Chips Facility (Arizona State University's Research Park, Tempe, Arizona) make custom TFLN chips available for sale into commercial markets such as electro-optical modulators, periodically poled frequency-conversion devices and micro ring resonator cavities.
